title: 领导与授权
subtitle: 建立责任、反馈和决策机制

questions.instruction: 选择这个词在管理中的意思。

questions.prompt: Effective leaders delegate clearly while retaining accountability.
questions.audio: Effective leaders delegate clearly while retaining accountability.
questions.answer: 高效的领导者会清晰授权，同时承担问责。
options: 高效的领导者会清晰授权，同时承担问责。
高效的领导者会把所有责任交给员工。
领导者只负责分配任务，不需要反馈。
员工必须独立决定所有预算。
questions.translation: 高效的领导者会清晰授权，同时承担问责。

questions.prompt: 听部门主管说明反馈效果。
questions.audio: Transparent feedback improved morale across the department.
questions.answer: 透明的反馈提升了整个部门的士气。
options: 透明的反馈提升了整个部门的士气。
反馈让部门停止了招聘。
部门的士气导致反馈变得保密。
透明的反馈降低了所有人的工资。
questions.translation: 透明的反馈提升了整个部门的士气。

questions.prompt: 主管鼓励团队在限定范围内独立决策。
questions.answer: The director encouraged independent decisions within agreed limits.
questions.audio: The director encouraged independent decisions within agreed limits.
questions.translation: 主管鼓励团队在限定范围内独立决策。

questions.prompt: Managers should _____ tasks according to each person's strengths.
questions.audio: Managers should delegate tasks according to each person's strengths.
questions.translation: 管理者应根据每个人的优势分配任务。

questions.prompt: 配对领导和团队管理中的词语。
questions.translation: 授权、问责、士气、反馈、责任归属、决策

questions.prompt: The final decision was assigned to the regional director.
questions.audio: The final decision was assigned to the regional director.
questions.answer: 地区主管负责最终决定。
options: 地区主管负责最终决定。
财务团队负责所有招聘。
questions.translation: 最终决定被交给了地区主管。

questions.prompt: 听团队说明责任如何被记录。
questions.audio: Each task is assigned to one owner so responsibility can be tracked.
questions.answer: 每项任务都分配给一名负责人，以便追踪责任。
options: 每项任务都分配给一名负责人，以便追踪责任。
每项任务由所有员工共同负责，无法追踪。
任务被取消后，负责人必须离职。
负责人只能追踪客户反馈，不能追踪任务。
questions.translation: 每项任务都分配给一名负责人，以便追踪责任。

questions.prompt: The new process _____ by the team last quarter.
questions.audio: The new process was adopted by the team last quarter.
questions.translation: 团队上季度采用了新流程。

dialogue.scene: 项目复盘中的职责分配

turns.speaker: director
turns.text: The launch went well, but several decisions were delayed because ownership was unclear.
turns.translation: 上线很顺利，但因为责任归属不清，有几个决定被耽搁了。

turns.speaker: lead
turns.text: I'll assign one owner to each workstream and record the decision limits.
turns.translation: 我会给每个工作流指定一名负责人，并记录决策权限。

turns.speaker: director
turns.text: Good. We need accountability without slowing the team down.
turns.translation: 很好。我们需要问责，但不能拖慢团队。

tasks.answer: Assign one owner to each workstream
options: Assign one owner to each workstream
Give every decision to the director
